fieldNotes.truckGate: Older 1949 urban bakery; multiple driveways open directly off Boot Road into a combined parking/yard area. No barrier arm, sliding gate, or checkpoint pinch-point visible in 2023-08 Street View of all road frontage.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth at any entrance. Small employee break gazebos near building 425 are not gate booths.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Constrained urban site - driveways run a short distance from Boot Road straight into the yard/dock area; little stacking depth.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: Boot Road frontage is tight with employee parking abutting the road; a truck queue at any driveway would quickly spill toward the public road - flagged as backup-sensitive.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: Three separate curb cuts onto Boot Road serving the parking lots and the east-end truck yard.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock canopies on the NE/east face of the main building plus dock positions on the secondary east-end building; ~12-20 doors estimated - band 10-25. Old facility, many doors hidden under canopies.
fieldNotes.dropArea: East-end yard holds parked trailers without tractors; ~10-15 - band 10-25.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Main bakery building plus a separate white-roofed warehouse/distribution structure at the east end share the lot; treated as the same campus so multipleFacilities left false (single cluster), buildingCount = 2.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Downingtown PA - dense industrial/commercial corridor along Boot Road with adjacent warehouses and residential townhouses across the street; classified Urban (Philadelphia exurban metro fabric).
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~14 acres from perimeter box (~220m N-S x ~470m E-W) - a compact older urban plant.
fieldNotes.railServed: Multi-track rail mainline runs along the north property edge but no spur enters the property; not rail-served.
fieldNotes.confidence: Building positively confirmed - a Campbell's-marked box truck and building 425 signage visible in Street View; Pepperidge Farm Downingtown plant at 421 Boot Road.
